description: This file defines an interface for log consistency protocol services used in Orleans, along with a custom exception class for protocol transport errors.

classes.name: ProtocolTransportException
classes.description: A custom exception class for protocol transport errors in Orleans, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the provided object.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs an error message related to the log consistency protocol.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught during the log consistency protocol.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs an exception that occurred in user code during a callback.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Outputs a message at a specified log level.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ProtocolTransportException, including inner exception details if present.
